parameters.name: DataSourceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the data sources that you want to disassociate from the backup policy.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup policy.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

*   **UDM_ECS**: ECS instance backup
